eval.title: Value Investing Is Hard In This Crazy Market (Buffett Lost Big On Apple)

call.headline_quote: so the key question with value investing is can I lose with Apple stock NOW Warren Buffett said yes you can

scenarios.name: worst
scenarios.quote: if it goes back to a p ratio of 17 we go to 110 which is not far from where the stock was just a year and a half ago

what_is_priced_in.quote: price earnings ratio of 44 dividend yield of 0.44% and if you look at Apple and the revenues there pretty much stagnant lately net income pretty much stagnant

reasons.claim: A P/E of 44 with stagnant revenue and net income is too expensive and explains why Buffett is selling.
reasons.quote: price earnings ratio of 44 dividend yield of 0.44% and if you look at Apple and the revenues there pretty much stagnant lately net income pretty much stagnant

data_check.gap_note: he says 44, as-of 37.3573 (FY2023); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: If the P/E reverts from 44 to a more normal 17, the stock would fall to around 110, a huge downside risk.
reasons.quote: if it goes back to a p ratio of 17 we go to 110 which is not far from where the stock was just a year and a half ago

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: terminal pe, implied price

reasons.claim: Apple's massive buybacks at a high price are not the smart kind of buyback Buffett favors, signaling overvaluation.
reasons.quote: Apple spent a 100 billion per year over the last few years on BuyBacks

data_check.gap_note: he says 1e+11, as-of -7.755e+10 (FY2023); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: Without a new product growth generator, current earnings may be peak earnings, adding risk.
reasons.quote: what will be the next growth generator which is a risk competition recession less purchasing so are these top maximum Apple earnings

data_check.gap_note: trajectory visible at T0; no number stated

reasons.claim: Apple has a strong ecosystem and products giving it a durable place in the market.
reasons.quote: great products great ecosystem and I'm filming this on an iPhone iMac iMovie editing whatever so it is there it has its place in the market

external_facts_used: Warren Buffett sold 50% of his Apple shares over recent quarters, reaching his highest ever cash position
389 million Apple shares sold last quarter at average estimated closing price of 186
Buffett bought Apple originally when P/E was around 10
Buffett is earning about 5% yield on treasuries with the proceeds
